name: Hushwing
description:
A velvet moth with a brass bell for a head. It has had enough of being rung. Free it in the linen room and it will quiet the hotel for you.

Q calls it at the resident under your reticle, within six paces and clear sight. Costs 1 summon charge. Its arrival interrupts the resident, holding it still for 3 seconds while you strike or retreat. It then folds its wings and leaves.
